title: M0: Review product concept and compatibility boundaries
body:
Approve terminal workflow, .NET 10 baseline, initial sidepulse-net command, aggregation priorities and explicit platform exclusions. Record decisions before C# scaffolding.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Port LED language and upstream validation vectors
body:
Verify escapes, 512-byte and 20-line limits, LED counts, brightness, invalid input and attributed fixtures against the pinned upstream revision.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Implement writable USB device transport on Windows
body:
Discover volumes, select destinations and write/flush programs. Verify a real Dot and removal, read-only and ambiguous-device cases.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Implement phone pairing and bridge delivery
body:
Pair original iOS app, protect credentials, support target selection and separate silent LED updates from visible notifications. Test offline delivery and show only supported acknowledgement levels.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Implement shared host and session state reduction
body:
Version current-user IPC, aggregate concurrent sessions, ignore late events, persist minimal restart metadata and serialize outputs. Hooks must not wait on network I/O.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Implement Copilot CLI hook integration
body:
Install/repair/remove dedicated hooks, handle real waiting notifications and turn ends, avoid permission decisions, preserve unrelated hooks and verify a real Windows CLI session.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Design and implement the Spectre terminal experience
body:
Prototype live dashboard/menu interaction, compact layout, session/device views, terminal capabilities, keyboard flow and plain/JSON/noninteractive modes.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M1: Add diagnostics, aliases and explicit migration
body:
Explain broken integrations/paths and transport failures; add device aliases and import preview/backup without modifying the existing Python port silently.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M2: Port remaining upstream integrations and remote relay
body:
Track Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok and Junie separately, plus relay and Android. Record payload compatibility and hardware verification per inventory row.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: M3: Build verified self-contained Windows releases
body:
Introduce release workflow after real projects/tests exist; produce x64/arm64 artifacts and checksums, verify install/uninstall and document signing/package-manager decisions.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.

title: Investigate firmware, raw USB and platform-specific helpers
body:
Decide feasibility and safety tests for firmware recovery, read-only USB control, Windows drivers, macOS guards/power helpers and the optional MLX classifier. Do not imply parity before verification.

See docs/wiki/Roadmap.md and docs/wiki/Compatibility.md.

Status: planned, implementation not started.
